name: Bruno Söhnle
tagline: Glashütte atelier making accessible classic watches since 2000
summary: Bruno Söhnle Uhrenatelier was founded in Glashütte in 2000 by a veteran of the Black Forest watch trade. It builds classic dress watches, chronographs and date-complication pieces, mostly with Swiss quartz movements plus refined Sellita- and Unitas-based mechanical calibres, at prices well below its Glashütte neighbours.
history:
Bruno Söhnle entered the watch business in 1957, aged 17, at his brother's Heges watch factory in Wurmberg on the edge of the Black Forest. Over the following four decades he built a career in watch sales and distribution from Wurmberg, including handling Swiss brands such as Epos for the German market.

In April 2000, as a present to himself for his 60th birthday, he founded his own brand, the Bruno Söhnle Uhrenatelier, in the Saxon watch town of Glashütte, starting with four employees. The first collections were classic wristwatches powered by Swiss Ronda quartz movements, finished and assembled in Glashütte.

Mechanical watches followed later: the hand-wound Mechanik-Edition I was presented in autumn 2008, and the first automatic collection arrived in 2010. In 2012 Bruno's daughter Stephanie Söhnle became managing director, and the atelier's building, the former Assmann house, was extensively renovated. The Facetta 1957 line appeared in 2014, and the Stuttgart collection followed in 2016, its Automatik Big winning a GQ Time Award in the entry-level category.

Today the atelier employs around 30 people, about 20 of them watchmakers, and offers roughly ten collections for men and women. Its mechanical models use in-house-modified 'Atelier calibres' such as the Sellita-based BS175 automatic and the Unitas-based BS 283 hand-wound movement, some with Glashütte-style finishing. The brand celebrated its 25th anniversary in 2025 with models such as the Pesaro I and Stuttgart III Big.
ownership: Family-owned (Söhnle family, led by Stephanie Söhnle)
knownFor: Affordable Glashütte-made classics like the Stuttgart and Pesaro
innovations: 2008: Mechanik-Edition I, the atelier's first hand-wound mechanical watch
2010: First automatic collection, presented at Inhorgenta
2016: Stuttgart Automatik Big wins the GQ Time Award in the entry-level category
2017: 'Workshop calibre' engraved with the signatures of family members

name: Circula
tagline: Pforzheim family brand reborn as a maker of hardened modern tool watches
summary: Circula was founded in Pforzheim in 1955 by Heinz Huber and is now run by his grandson Cornelius Huber. Revived as a direct-to-consumer brand, it makes Swiss-powered dive, field, pilot and steel sports watches such as the AquaSport, ProTrail and Facet, many with hardened cases and designs by Guy Bove.
history:
The Huber family entered the watch trade in 1926 with Huber & Co., a watch and jewellery wholesaler in Pforzheim, the traditional centre of the German watch and jewellery industry. In 1955 Heinz Huber launched the Circula brand, its name inspired by the circulating motion of the balance wheel in a mechanical movement.

Heinz's son Klaus-Dieter Huber later took over the business, which concentrated on wholesale. Like much of the European industry, Circula moved to quartz movements in the quartz era, and the brand survived mainly through a loyal domestic clientele, with the wholesale business eventually wound down.

The revival came from the third generation. Cornelius Huber, who had been given a 1955 Circula by his parents, tested the waters with crowdfunded models before returning the brand fully to mechanical movements. The 1970s-inspired AquaSport skin diver, developed with input from hundreds of members of a German watch forum, became the brand's international breakthrough, followed by the Super-Compressor-cased SuperSport in 2021. Cornelius formally took over management in 2019 and shifted Circula to direct online sales worldwide.

Since 2023 Circula has built a 'Pro' series of modern tool watches with hardened, sandblasted steel cases: the ProTrail field watch (2023), the ProFlight pilot's watch (2024) and the ProSea diver (2025), the latter two designed with former IWC and TAG Heuer creative director Guy Bove, who also designed the faceted Facet sports watch launched in late 2024. The brand celebrated its 70th anniversary in 2025, still based in Pforzheim.
knownFor: AquaSport skin diver and hardened 'Pro' series tool watches
innovations: 2021: SuperSport revives the 1950s–70s Super-Compressor case, sealed by water pressure, with an internal rotating bezel
2023: ProTrail case surface-hardened to about 1,200 Vickers
2024: ProFlight uses a soft-iron cage for antimagnetism to 80,000 A/m
2025: ProSea dial textured after the skin of a manta ray

funFacts: The name Circula refers to the circulating motion of a mechanical watch's balance wheel.
Movement parts once arrived at the family business wrapped in silk paper and stacked in repurposed banana boxes, which a young Cornelius helped sort.
The original AquaSport was shaped by the feedback of more than 400 members of a German watch forum.
The brand motto 'GADA' stands for 'Go Anywhere. Do Anything.'

models.name: AquaSport II
models.description: Circula's signature 1970s-style skin diver, with a wave-patterned dial, two-tone sapphire bezel and bright orange accents; the model that put the revived brand on the map.

models.name: ProTrail Power+
models.description: A modern field watch with a hardened, faceted case, full Arabic dial with 24-hour inner track, heat-blued hands and Old Radium lume, best known in its saturated Sand colour.

models.name: ProFlight Power+
models.movement: Sellita SW200-2 Power+ Elaboré, automatic, in soft-iron cage
models.description: Circula's first pilot's watch and the first model to carry the new logo, reworking the Flieger layout with an open triangle at 12, blued hands and an orange seconds hand.

models.name: ProSea
models.description: A Guy Bove-designed modern diver launched for the brand's 70th anniversary, with a manta-ray-textured dial, ceramic bezel and hardened faceted case.

models.name: Facet 38
models.description: A faceted integrated-bracelet sports watch designed with Guy Bove, with a dial embossed in a pattern of stylised cog wheels from the Circula logo; the brand's move upmarket.
